result.reason: The operative language does not reach the playbook position. It provides a software conformity warranty for the entire term and repair/replacement followed by termination and refund, but omits the required professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, services warranty period, and compliance-with-laws warranty. The malicious-code protection is narrower than the requested standard. It also unnecessarily adds title and non-infringement warranties and expands software coverage beyond the specified 12-month preferred or 90-day fallback period. The surviving statement that documentation nonconformities may not be corrected conflicts with the cure remedy, notwithstanding the general exception. The margin comment cannot cure these operative defects and additionally proposes an SLA beyond the stated rule.
